parameters.query:
SELECT cm.*,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nps_responses nr WHERE nr.client_id = cm.id AND nr.score >= 9 AND nr.submitted_at > now() - interval '6 months') AS promoter_survey_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referrals r WHERE r.referrer_client_id = cm.id AND r.status = 'reward_pending') AS successful_referral_count
FROM clients_master cm
WHERE cm.advocate_flag IS NOT TRUE
  AND (
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nps_responses nr WHERE nr.client_id = cm.id AND nr.score >= 9 AND nr.submitted_at > now() - interval '6 months') >= 2
    OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referrals r WHERE r.referrer_client_id = cm.id AND r.status = 'reward_pending') >= 2
  );
